title: Edge chromatic number of the even complete graph
statement: For every integer $n \ge 1$, the complete graph $K_{2n}$ on $2n$ vertices has edge chromatic number $\chi'(K_{2n}) = 2n - 1$; equivalently, the chromatic number of the line graph of $K_{2n}$ equals $2n - 1$.
hypotheses_covered: n is a natural number with 0 < n
the graph is the complete graph on 2n vertices
replaced:
